text: Through the village lanes and along the boundary paths of the farmland, the Kankurang surged with breathtaking speed.
His red fibers trailed like living flames, and in each hand he gripped a heavy iron cutlass.
As he leapt into the moonlit square, he struck the two blades together — CLANG!
— sending bright sparks showering into the dust.
Children scurried indoors, women ceased their chatter, and any who harbored deceit in their thoughts felt a cold shiver down their spines.
The clanging iron proclaimed that peace, order, and absolute restraint now governed the settlement.
